title: Better Villages & Luki's Grand Capitals Compatibility
description: Compatibility patch for Better Villages and Luki's Grand Capitals.
body:
# Better Villages & Luki's Grand Capitals Compatibility

A compatibility addon that allows **Better Villages** and **Luki's Grand Capitals** to work together without village generation conflicts.

---

## 📖 About

Both **Better Villages** and **Luki's Grand Capitals** greatly improve Minecraft's villages, each with its own unique style and structures. Unfortunately, using them together can lead to generation conflicts.

This compatibility addon resolves those conflicts, allowing both projects to coexist seamlessly in the same world.

The result is a much greater variety of villages, combining the best of both mods and creating more diverse settlements throughout your adventures.

I created this addon because I didn't want to choose between the two—both generate beautiful villages and deserve a place in the same modpack.

---

## ✨ Features

- ✔️ Compatibility between Better Villages and Luki's Grand Capitals
- ✔️ Fixes village generation conflicts
- ✔️ Greater village variety
- ✔️ Seamless integration with world generation

---

## 📦 Dependencies

This addon requires the following projects:

- [Better Villages](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-village)
- [Luki's Grand Capitals](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lukis-grand-capitals)

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **0.16.0+**
- Fabric API

---

## ❗ Important

This is a compatibility addon and does **not** add any content on its own.

Both **Better Villages** and **Luki's Grand Capitals** must be installed for this addon to function properly.
